title: Honor launches its Watch 6 Pro smartwatch, the world's first product to sport an OLED display produced using a lithography process
content: Honor just announced its latest smartwatch, the Watch 6 Pro which sports a 1.5" 466 x 466 5,500 nits (peak brightness) tandem AMOLED. The high-end display is produced by Visionox using its ViP maskless process - this is perhaps the first commercial display that is produced with a maskless OLED process.

title: Samsung reshuffles DRAM roadmap, prioritizing B1b hybrid bonding for D0a, HBM5
content: Samsung Electronics is reshaping its next-generation dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) roadmap, elevating its B1b wafer-to-wafer (W2W) hybrid bonding technology from a project-specific development to the core technology behind D0a, its first sub-10nm DRAM generation. Industry observers believe Samsung's push to commercialize B1b DRAM earlier could also benefit its next-generation high-bandwidth memory (HBM) products, including HBM5.

title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics to invest US$5 billion in ABF substrate expansion
content: Samsung Electro-Mechanics said it will invest KRW6.78 trillion (about US$5 billion) in South Korea and Vietnam to expand ABF substrate production for AI servers and high-performance computing (HPC) markets. Part of the funding reportedly comes from advance payments by Nvidia and other global technology companies.
